annotations.title: ISBN check, validate an ISBN: check whether an ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 book number is valid

description: Check an ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 check digit and convert valid ISBN-10s to ISBN-13. Hyphens and spaces are ignored. Use before cataloguing or ordering books. Example: isbn=0-306-40615-2. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
